tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Ти — свідок поєдинку. Пізніше Стілґар попросить тебе записати все для пам'яті племені. А Пол прийде до тебе й захоче почути чесно: що він мав зробити інакше?
tasks.q_pl: Jesteś świadkiem pojedynku. Później Stilgar poprosi cię o zapisanie wszystkiego dla pamięci plemienia. A Paul przyjdzie do ciebie i będzie chciał usłyszeć szczerze: co powinien był zrobić inaczej?
tasks.q_en: You are a witness to the duel. Later Stilgar will ask you to write everything down for the tribe's memory. And Paul will come to you wanting to hear honestly what he should have done differently.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Should have / shouldn't have + past participle = criticism or regret about the past (Jamis shouldn't have challenged the boy; I should have warned him). Could have + past participle = a possibility that wasn't used (Stilgar could have warned us). Needn't have = we did it, but it wasn't necessary. Had to = there was no choice (Paul had to accept the challenge).
tasks.q_pl: Should have / shouldn't have + past participle = criticism or regret about the past (Jamis shouldn't have challenged the boy; I should have warned him). Could have + past participle = a possibility that wasn't used (Stilgar could have warned us). Needn't have = we did it, but it wasn't necessary. Had to = there was no choice (Paul had to accept the challenge).

Had to = there was no choice (Paul had to accept the challenge).

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Пол довго мовчить. «Фримени сказали, що я дав воду мертвому… Вони вперше подивилися на мене як на свого». До вас тихо підходить Чані. Вона нічого не каже — просто сідає поруч із Полом і дивиться в ту саму темряву.
end_good.text_pl: Paul długo milczy. „Fremeni powiedzieli, że dałem wodę zmarłemu… Pierwszy raz spojrzeli na mnie jak na swojego”. Cicho podchodzi do was Chani. Nic nie mówi — po prostu siada obok Paula i patrzy w tę samą ciemność.
end_good.text_en: Paul is silent for a long time. “The Fremen said I gave water to the dead… For the first time they looked at me as one of their own.” Chani quietly comes over. She says nothing; she simply sits down beside Paul and looks into the same darkness.

tasks.q_pl: Wieczorem Paul siada obok ciebie z dala od ognia. „Powiedz mi szczerze. Co powinienem był zrobić inaczej? Kto mógł to zatrzymać?” Odpowiadaj o przeszłości: powinien był, nie trzeba było, mógł.
tasks.q_en: In the evening Paul sits down beside you, away from the fire. “Tell me honestly. What should I have done differently? Who could have stopped it?” Answer about the past: should have, shouldn't have, could have.
